# Aggregated build for auto-generated libraries. Each subdirectory wraps a
# dependency that is produced by an external tool (acados C codegen) and whose
# configuration YAMLs live alongside the generated code under its own
# configs/ folder. This isolates autogenerated artefacts from the example
# implementation code under ../examples_cpp and ../ejemplos_py.

add_subdirectory(acados_position_mpc)
add_subdirectory(acados_trajectory_mpc)
